issue_request: FHIR-15941 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for STU3 Pharmacy. It requested a way to record rationale when medication is not recommended or not ordered, and the final resolution was to align MedicationRequest to Request by adding doNotPerform as a modifier and updating reasonCode/reasonReference to specify reasons for prescribing or not prescribing.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite GForge/SVN build r13840. Git commit 3ca8aaddb2c50c08732cad49f8ab68f086ba8c83 corresponds to that application and added MedicationRequest.doNotPerform to the old spreadsheet source while changing reason text to cover ordering or not ordering medication. The active source was later refactored into source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. Later source evolution merged reasonCode/reasonReference into MedicationRequest.reason as a CodeableReference, and later Pharmacy decisions FHIR-26594 and FHIR-47856 refined doNotPerform and reason. FHIR-47856 explicitly rejected adding a doNotPerformReason element and clarified that MedicationRequest.reason covers ordering medication to be taken or not taken; that related issue already has a combined-branch reconciliation commit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current XML source has doNotPerform as a modifier, says its reason can be provided in .reason, and defines MedicationRequest.reason as the reason or indication for ordering medication to be taken or not taken. The current doNotPerform example also uses a reason reference for the negative medication order.
